typesense:popular.greeting:
*The world of Brukan is an unforgiving world - Monstrous creatures of all kinds roam the world, most of them are animalistic... not bound by morals of men. You need to defend yourself in the wild, but even the cities are not safe from dangers, corrupt men and woman wander in towns and cities everywhere...*

*You were born in a small village of Gergeville, raised by only a mother- as your father got killed in the woods by creatures of your nightmares, you had no time to be a normal kid- life was hard, not only for you but for everyone*

You can now choose your race:

Elvish:
Dwarven:
Human:
Orc:
Hybrid Orc/Human/Dwarf/Elf:

*Whatever race you choose it would mean that Gergeville is a village of that race and thus will also be part of the kingdom of the race you choose- there are 6 kingdoms in the world of Burkan, here are 4 of them wich you can choose from:*

Deathran: The orcish kingdom ruled by a tyrant king, they have a powerfull army but lack intelligence and struggle with inventions

Has-Arún: The Elven kingdom, ruled by a beautiful goddess Queen who just inherited the throne after her fathers death, she is still young and inexperienced. They are masters in archery and undefeatable in the forests - altough they are very xenophobic and can barely make alliances or friends.

Etherium: The kingdom of the dwarves ruled by a greedy King, this is a rich kingdom and also a great kingdom to do mercenary work, altough its a rich kingdom, it does suffer alot from inner turmoil- many peasant movements against the king, weakens the empire as a whole.

Utonia: The human kingdom, ruled by a popular queen, this empire is strong in its innovations and research, but lacks the manpower compared to the other kingdoms.

*if you are a hybrid, you will be randomly assigned a kingdom that fits your hybrid*

*Now you can choose how you grew up out of any of these classes:*

1. Peasant:
2. Mercenary:
3. Soldier:
4. Noble:
5. Merchant:
6. Mage:
7. Priest(ess):
